reason: A web UI plugin that renders Mermaid code blocks in conversation messages as interactive, theme-aware diagram cards with zoom, fullscreen, and source-preview controls.

summaries.zh: 在对话界面中将 Mermaid 代码块渲染为支持缩放、全屏和源码预览的交互式图表卡片。
summaries.en: Renders Mermaid code blocks in conversation messages as interactive diagram cards with zoom, fullscreen, and source-preview controls.

capabilities: Detects Mermaid code blocks in conversation messages
Renders Mermaid diagrams as interactive cards
Provides zoom, fit-width, fullscreen, and preview/code controls
Loads the Mermaid renderer lazily from jsDelivr
Adapts rendering to application theme and locale
